# Giacobbi's Cucina Citta

> Family-owned Italian-American restaurant at 59 Allen St. (at Franklin), Buffalo, NY 14202, in the Allentown neighborhood. Run by the Jacobbi family, whose earlier restaurant was Carmine's on Transit Road. Open since May 2016.

## Essentials
- Phone: (716) 834-4000
- Hours: Wed–Sat bar 4:30pm, kitchen 5–10pm; Sun 4–9pm; closed Mon–Tue
- Reservations: https://resy.com/cities/buffalo-ny/venues/giacobbis
- Pickup ordering: https://ordering.chownow.com/order/20612/locations
- Delivery: DoorDash
- Parking: lot behind the restaurant, entered from Delaware next to Tempo; public after 6pm weekdays and all day weekends
- Catering: drop-off catering trays for offices, parties and holidays

## Known for
- Lasagna, eggplant lasagna (a Carmine's recipe), Tortellini alla Giacobbi, chicken parmesan, chicken Milanese, peanut butter pie, house cocktails
